        From 608d90117ff950cce0e21c710fedeeb55a3d4963 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Thomas Szymczak <thomasthekitty@hotmail.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Oct 2014 13:43:27 -0400
Subject: [PATCH] Fix typo in pvq.c

This fixes an issue that was introduced in commit
f1a9307c8752883e8692476de72a0e1f9665ba30, "Add a 32x32 transform (and
inverse)."

Because of this bug, changing OD_DISABLE_QM to 1 in internal.h doesn't work.

Signed-off-by: Jean-Marc Valin <jmvalin@jmvalin.ca>
---
 src/pvq.c | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/src/pvq.c b/src/pvq.c
index 023500f..2642c4b 100644
--- a/src/pvq.c
+++ b/src/pvq.c
@@ -87,7 +87,7 @@ static const double OD_PVQ_BETA32_LUMA[10] = {1.5, 1.5, 1.5, 1.5, 1.5, 1.5,
 static const int OD_PVQ_QM4_CB_Q4[2] = {8, 16};
 static const int OD_PVQ_QM8_CB_Q4[5] = {8, 16, 16, 16, 16};
 static const int OD_PVQ_QM16_CB_Q4[8] = {8, 16, 16, 16, 16, 16, 16, 16};
-static const int OD_PVQ_QM32_CB_q4[11] = {8, 16, 16, 16, 16, 16, 16, 16,
+static const int OD_PVQ_QM32_CB_Q4[11] = {8, 16, 16, 16, 16, 16, 16, 16,
  16, 16, 16};
 
 #define OD_PVQ_QM4_CR_Q4 OD_PVQ_QM4_CB_Q4
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by a typo in the variable name for the constant array that defines quantization matrix values for a 32x32 transform. The incorrect naming (`OD_PVQ_QM32_CB_q4`) led to issues when attempting to change the `OD_DISABLE_QM` setting in `internal.h`, as the code was referencing the wrong variable, which would not yield the expected behavior. The fix involved correcting the variable name to `OD_PVQ_QM32_CB_Q4`, ensuring that the correct quantization matrix is used.
